---
title: "A format extension reads its own metadata files"
format: metafile-html
toc: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    metafile-html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<h2 id="toc-title">Contents from the extension metadata file</h2>']
        - []
---

## Section

The `metafile` extension sets `metadata-files` for its HTML format, and the file sets `toc-title`.
Before the fix, Quarto looked for the file in the wrong directory and ignored it without a message.
The table of contents must show the title from this file.
